function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you find the best place to order a cake—whether it’s for a birthday, wedding, corporate event, or just a sweet treat.

---

## 1️⃣ Decide What Kind of Cake You Want

| Type | Typical Sources |
|------|-----------------|
| **Custom‑decorated** (e.g., photo cakes, themed designs) | Local artisan bakers, specialty cake shops, custom cake designers on Etsy |
| **Standard ready‑made** (e.g., chocolate, vanilla, fruit) | Grocery stores (Costco, Walmart, Target), big‑box supermarkets, local chain bakeries |
| **Dietary‑specific** (gluten‑free, vegan, keto, sugar‑free) | Health‑food stores, specialty bakeries, online health‑food retailers |
| **Bulk / wholesale** (large parties, catering) | Wholesale clubs (Sam’s Club, BJ’s), catering companies, bulk bakery suppliers |

---

## 2️⃣ Where to Order From

### A. Online Delivery Platforms  
These aggregate many local bakeries and allow you to see menus, photos, and reviews all in one place.

| Platform | Highlights | How to Use |
|----------|------------|------------|
| **Uber Eats** | Huge selection, real‑time tracking | Search “cake” + your city; filter by rating |
| **DoorDash** | Often offers free delivery over $25 | Same as above; look for “specialty desserts” |
| **Postmates** | Good for last‑minute orders | Check “Desserts & Bakery” category |
| **Instacart** | Shop at local grocery stores, get delivery | Add cake to cart, choose delivery slot |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Fresh produce & baked goods delivered | Browse “Bakery” section, add to cart |

> *Tip:* Many of these apps let you set a delivery window so you’re not left waiting.

### B. Direct Bakery Websites / Apps  
If you have a favorite local shop, ordering directly often gives you more control over customization and sometimes better pricing.

| Bakery | What to Look For | Contact |
|--------|------------------|---------|
| **Local Artisan Bakeries** | Custom design, seasonal flavors | Search “[city] artisan bakery” |
| **Chain Bakeries** (e.g., **Cakes.com**, **Bakeology**) | Nationwide shipping, consistent quality | Visit their site, use “Order Now” button |
| **Specialty Shops** (e.g., **Vegan Cakes Co.**) | Dietary‑friendly options | Check “Menu” tab, call for custom orders |

### C. Grocery Stores & Big‑Box Chains  

| Store | Why Choose Them | Ordering Options |
|-------|-----------------|------------------|
| **Walmart** | Affordable, wide availability | In‑store pickup or online order |
| **Target** | Convenient, often has a bakery section | Same as above |
| **Costco** | Bulk sizes, great deals | Membership required, order online |
| **Whole Foods** | Organic ingredients, high quality | Order through Amazon Prime |

### D. Specialty Marketplaces  

| Marketplace | Best For | How to Find |
|-------------|----------|-------------|
| **Etsy** | Handmade, unique designs | Search “custom cake” + your city |
| **Facebook Marketplace / Nextdoor** | Local sellers, sometimes cheaper | Join local groups, post “Looking for a cake” |
| **Craigslist** | Bargain deals, local vendors | Search “cakes” under “services” |

---

## 3️⃣ Tips for a Smooth Order

| Tip | Why It Matters |
|-----|----------------|
| **Check Reviews** | Helps gauge quality and reliability |
| **Ask About Packaging** | Ensures safe transport, especially for delicate designs |
| **Confirm Delivery Time** | Avoid surprises, especially for events |
| **Clarify Cancellation Policy** | Some places charge a fee if you cancel late |
| **Mention Allergies Early** | Prevent cross‑contamination, especially for gluten‑free or nut allergies |
| **Provide Clear Instructions** | For custom designs, include photos or sketches |
| **Consider a Small Test Order** | Try a sample before committing to a large quantity |

---

## 4️⃣ Quick Starter List (U.S. Examples)

| City | Recommended Bakery / Service |
|------|------------------------------|
| New York | **Magnolia Bakery** (online & in‑store) |
| Los Angeles | **Baked by Melissa** (delivery via Uber Eats) |
| Chicago | **The Sweet Spot** (custom cakes, local) |
| Houston | **Sweet Life Bakery** (online orders, local pickup) |
| Miami | **Cake Couture** (Instagram orders, local) |

> *Note:* Replace the city with your own for tailored recommendations.

---

## 5️⃣ Final Checklist Before Placing Your Order

1. **What flavor & size?**  
2. **Any dietary restrictions?**  
3. **Decoration preferences?**  
4. **Delivery address & time?**  
5. **Budget?**  
6. **Contact details for confirmation?**

Once you’ve answered those questions, you’ll be ready to place an order confidently—whether you’re using a delivery app, calling a local shop, or shopping online.

Happy cake hunting! 🎂
